questions.question: Nais sanang sumama ni Monique sa pamamasyal ng pamilya ngunit hindi mawala-wala ang kanyang liyo. Ang ibig sabihin ng salitang LIYO ay:
questions.explanation: “hilo” ang kasingkahulugan ng “liyo”

questions.question: Uuwi lamang ng bahay si Arnel galing sa paglalaro kung makikita ang nanay na may dalang pamipi. Ang ibig sabihin ng salitang PAMIPI ay:
questions.explanation: “pamalo” ang kasingkahulugan ng “pamipi”

questions.question: Mag-uumpisa na ang klase ngunit hindi pa rin maapuhap ni Nerie ang kanyang mga gamit. Ang ibig sabihin ng salitang MAAPUHAP ay:
questions.explanation: “mahanap” ang kasingkahulugan ng “maapuhap”

questions.question: Hindi na nakatiis si Peter sa panunudyo ng kanyang kaklase kung kaya sya ay nagsumbong na sa kanyang guro. Ang ibig sabihin ng salitang PANUNUDYO ay:
questions.explanation: “panunukso” ang kasingkahulugan ng “panunudyo”

questions.question: Kahit mali ang amo ni Julio, wala siyang magawa kindi ito ay katigan. Ang kasalungat ng salitang KATIGAN ay:
questions.explanation: “kontrahin” ang kasalungat ng “katigan”

questions.question: Even though Karen has an average-paying job, she’s living like a maggot in bacon. LIVING LIKE A MAGGOT IN BACON means:
questions.explanation: “living luxuriously” is what the idiom “living like a maggot” means

questions.question: Nelson said he manhandled all three thieves out of the store but Sarah thinks he’s just inflating the cow. INFLATING THE COW means:
questions.explanation: “exaggerating” is what the idiom “inflating the cow” means

questions.question: Banning trucks and busses in the city can cut both ways. CUT BOTH WAYS means:
options: Will have both positive and negative effects
questions.explanation: “will have both positive and negative effects” is what the idiom “cut both ways” means

questions.question: When Mona discovered that Lisa had cheated, she was determined to even the score. EVEN THE SCORE means:
options: tell the person that it’s wrong
questions.explanation: “get revenge” is what the idiom “even the score” means

questions.question: The authority is examining the scene of the crime and they are doing it with a fine-tooth comb. DOING SOMETHING WITH A FINE-TOOTH COMB means:
options: do the job with insufficient tools
questions.explanation: “examine something thoroughly” is what the idiom “do something with a fine-toothed comb” means

questions.question: Divine is on a diet but the luscious dinner made her eat more than usual. The antonym of the word LUSCIOUS is:
questions.explanation: unpalatable is an antonym of luscious

questions.question: In the exigency of the service, Roland was designated as the officer-in-charge of the planning division. The synonym of the word EXIGENCY is:
questions.explanation: demand is a synonym of exigency

questions.question: Two disheveled members of Amy’s guard were with her in a dark, blurry cage. The antonym of the word DISHEVELED is:
questions.explanation: tidy is an antonym of disheveled

questions.question: To pay legally, the housemaid is considered an employee and will need to disburse social security and income taxes. The synonym of the word DISBURSE is:
questions.explanation: pay out is a synonym of disburse

questions.question: Katarina is keen on the reportage style of photographs. The antonym of the word KEEN is:
questions.explanation: dull is an antonym of keen

questions.question: Throughout Marc’s life as a single guy, he was profligate and a spendthrift. PROFLIGATE means:
questions.explanation: wasteful is a synonym of profligate

questions.question: Everybody thought that Joyce was a shy person when in reality, she’s vociferous. All the words below are synonyms of the word VOCIFEROUS except:
questions.explanation: soft is an antonym of vociferous

questions.question: In first-world countries, a traditional bourgeois family consists of two parents, two children, and a family pet BOURGEOIS mean:
questions.explanation: middle-class is the meaning of bourgeois

questions.question: It takes a copious amount of food to suppress Katrina’s appetite. All the words below are antonyms of the word COPIOUS except:
questions.explanation: abundant is a synonym of copious

questions.question: The outgoing principal made an extemporaneous speech that turned out to be more heartfelt than the prepared statement she had lost. EXTEMPORANEOUS means

questions.question: Once you get big in the world of social media, you must be ready to face the scurrilous attacks of your bashers. SCURRILOUS means:
questions.explanation: slanderous is a synonym of scurrilous

questions.question: Michelle is normally calm and level-headed, so her outburst is an aberration. ABERRATION means:
questions.explanation: rarity is a synonym of aberration

questions.question: The statement presented by the sole witness to the crime sounds apocryphal. The synonym of the word APOCRYPHAL is:
questions.explanation: fictitious is a synonym of apocryphal

questions.question: Safety guidelines exist for a reason, and if we flout them, there could be serious consequences. The antonym of the word FLOUT is:
questions.explanation: follow is a synonym of flout

questions.question: To Mr. Sherlock, the victim’s wife appeared mawkish as though she was putting on an act. The antonym of the word MAWKISH is:
questions.explanation: calm is an antonym of mawkish

questions.question: There should be a law against treating senior citizens with such irreverence. The meaning of the word IRREVERENCE is:
questions.explanation: disrespect is a synonym of irreverence

questions.question: If you do not clean the cat’s litter box regularly, a noisome aroma will fill your house. The antonym of the word NOISOME is:
questions.explanation: good is an antonym of noisome

questions.question: There is a regrettable paucity of training in the rudiments of security protocols or practices at the hospital. The synonym of the word PAUCITY is:
questions.explanation: insufficient is a synonym of paucity

questions.question: The motif of the wall is rife with mystical associations that will be discussed later. The synonym of the word RIFE is:
questions.explanation: widespread is a synonym of rife

questions.question: The front-liners were not prepared for the surfeit of patients that came in during the pandemic. The antonym of the word SURFEIT is:
questions.explanation: lack is an antonym of surfeit

questions.question: Linette has been on the ball since she was hired as a secretary.
questions.explanation: doing a good job is the meaning of the idiom “on the ball”

questions.question: Buying a new phone these days costs an arm and leg.
questions.explanation: very expensive is the meaning of the idiom “costs an arm and leg”

questions.question: Eliza wants to talk to Jason but he’s giving her the cold shoulder.
questions.explanation: ignoring someone is the meaning of the idiom “giving the cold shoulder”

questions.question: Looking before you leap will help you make fewer mistakes.
options: asking for help before doing a task
questions.explanation: take only calculated risks is the meaning of the idiom “looking before you leap”

questions.question: You can’t have your cake and eat it too.
options: you can’t eat too many desserts
you can’t have too many gifts
you can’t make a good decision
questions.explanation: you can’t have everything is the meaning of the idiom “you can’t have your own cake and eat it too/you can’t eat your own cake”

questions.question: Sinubukang ipaliwanag ni Pedro sitwasyon ngunit alimbuyugin si Juan. Ang kasalungat ng salitang ALIMBUYUGIN ay:
questions.explanation: “malawak ang pag-iisip” ay ang kasalungat ng alimbuyugin

questions.question: Ang pagiging gaso ni Estela ang maghahatid sa kanya sa kapahamakan. Ang kasalungat ng salitang GASO ay:
questions.explanation: “mahinhin” ang kasalungat ng gaso

questions.explanation: “sinungaling” ang ibig sabihin ng sawikain na mapaglubid ng buhangin

questions.explanation: “mayaman” ang ibig sabihin ng sawikain na may sinasabi
